# Coding 0.6.2

This release makes Coding more comfortable for long-running desktop work, with
a native dark theme, calmer interaction prompts, stronger approval boundaries,
and faster restoration of existing conversations.

## Highlights

- Choose light, dark, or system appearance. The complete desktop surface,
  provider artwork, and application icon now adapt cleanly to the selected
  theme.
- Long conversations keep the title bar and Composer stable. Streaming output
  respects manual scrolling, and a compact new-content control returns you to
  the latest message when you are reading earlier context.
- Command approvals now replace the Composer temporarily and show the complete
  command before a decision. The same focused flow works in the main
  conversation and the right-side panel.
- Guided questions have clearer hierarchy, polished single- and multi-select
  states, visible progress, and a consistent submit action.

## Safety and reliability

- Approval checks now cover sensitive paths and shell or background operations
  more consistently, while preserving the command context shown to the user.
- Conversation history is restored lazily, reducing startup work for users with
  many saved sessions.
- Usage accounting now uses a SQLite ledger for more durable, efficient
  aggregation.
- Background task lifecycle, file search behavior, and desktop UI regression
  coverage have been strengthened.

## Downloads and current limitations

DMG and ZIP builds are available for Apple Silicon (`arm64`) and Intel (`x64`)
Macs running macOS 12 or later. Windows and Linux builds are not included.

The macOS builds are ad-hoc signed, but are not signed with an Apple Developer
ID certificate and are not notarized. macOS may require approval under
**System Settings > Privacy & Security** after the first launch attempt.

The embedded browser should currently be used only with content you trust.
Dedicated isolation for untrusted pages is not complete.
